title: Early Civilisation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts (to confirm): Swahili city-states Mombasa, Malindi, Lamu, Kilwa, Zanzibar; trade by monsoon dhows with Arabia, Persia, India and China; Kiswahili is a Bantu language with Arabic loan words.

skills.key_step: The child names the Swahili city-states, their trade partners and goods, and what the civilisation gave the world.

floor.prerequisite: Gives the factors of the Indian Ocean trade.
floor.question: What carried dhows across the Indian Ocean?

steps: Name its gifts: Kiswahili, coral-stone building, coastal culture.

board.do: Draw the coast with five dots.

board.say: Which city-state is here, in Tanzania?

misconceptions.ask: Which of these was a Swahili city-state?
misconceptions.repair: Find the coast on a map.

misconceptions.ask: With whom did the Swahili trade by dhow?
misconceptions.repair: Look at the monsoon winds on a map.
Ask which words are Bantu and which came from trade.

misconceptions.ask: What were many Swahili houses and mosques built of?
misconceptions.repair: Show photos of coral-stone buildings in Lamu and Gedi.

checks.question: Name two Swahili city-states.
checks.answer: any two of: Mombasa, Malindi, Lamu, Kilwa, Zanzibar

checks.question: What is Kiswahili?
checks.answer: a Bantu language with some Arabic words
